trailhead.label: Plan de Ville in the centre of Saint-Pierre-de-Chartreuse, the board’s start

cautions: Clay stretches between Merlatière and the orchid path, and the drop to the Couzon after Carlinière, can be slippery after rain; one short steep section.
A departmental road is crossed halfway round, and the start and end follow village streets.
Several footbridges over the Couzon stream.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
